parts.text: A long tube contains oil. A small ball is held at rest at the surface of the oil. At time t = 0, the ball is released and begins to fall vertically through the oil. Fig. 1.1 shows the ball falling through the oil. Fig. 1.1 As the ball begins to fall through the oil, it accelerates.
